tool.name: GninaSelectPose
tool.description: Selects a single pose in the output of the gnina_run building block.

param.name: input_sdf_path
param.help: Path to the SDF file with the docked poses written by the gnina_run building block

param.name: outname_output_sdf_path
param.help: Path to the output SDF file with the selected pose

param.name: config_json
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax
